### Part 1: Industry Options & Software Tools

The podcast-to-shorts landscape is divided into two main categories: **AI-driven repurposing tools** (which automate the finding and cutting of clips) and **manual/creative editing suites** (which give you precise control over visuals, pacing, and styling).
